calendarSync.title: Sync Google Calendar
calendarSync.description: Sends each connected calendar the confirmed or paid bookings it does not have yet. A professional's calendar receives the sessions they perform; an administrator's receives every booking in the centre. Running it again duplicates nothing, and whatever an administrator has on their own calendar never takes hours away from the public.

type.splitDesc: Two subjects or two versions; the better one goes to the rest of the list.
type.dateBasedDesc: Sent around a date on the contact, such as a birthday or an anniversary.
type.rssDesc: Goes out whenever the blog publishes something new.
